doc.title: Ignacio Berroa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 24, 2021 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Opening and the Glenn Miller connection
summary: Rowe welcomes Berroa from Miami; both recall Glenn Miller catching their ear as youths.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: I’m very pleased to have Ignacio Berroa with me this morning, from Miami. And I’m in New York in Hamilton College and my name is Monk Rowe. Thanks a lot for joining me.
My pleasure, thank you for having me, Monk.
You know we, before our quote film was rolling, I think we have something in common in that Glenn Miller caught our ear in our youth. Is that correct?

Right. So musicians talk about, especially in the older vernacular about paying dues. And it’s clear to me you’ve paid some dues simply to get here in the States, but before that I’m wondering was there any question about what your livelihood was going to be even before you came to the United States? At what point did you decide I’m going to be a musician?
